investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Atlasfold Assurance (insurance); Platform: on-premises data center DC-Central, server range 172.23.0.0/16; Two data centers DC-A and DC-B linked by routed interconnects with a stretched VLAN 50; legacy PostgreSQL primary/standby pair (db-a in DC-A, db-b in DC-B) behind a keepalived VRRP virtual IP 172.23.149.74 with a promote-on-MASTER script; network automation: Ansible AWX pushes router ACLs (job IDs AWX-); Change management: production changes carry CR- identifiers.
